deadline.value: Apply by December 1 (2026) for Fall 2027; TOEFL scores must arrive by December 1 or the file is not reviewed.
deadline.quote: Fall Deadline December 1 | If TOEFL scores are not received by December 1st, the application will not be reviewed.

gre_subject.value: No Psychology Subject GRE policy is stated.

gre_general.value: The GRE is not required, but submitted scores are considered.
gre_general.quote: The Graduate Record Exam (GRE) is not required. Students may submit GRE scores as part of their application which will be taken under consideration by the Neuroscience Admissions Committee.

supervisor.value: You do three lab rotations in the first year before choosing a major professor.
supervisor.quote: During the first year, students complete three laboratory rotations.

funding.value: Each student gets a five-year stipend covering tuition, fees, living costs and health insurance, but support for international students is limited, so fewer international places exist.
funding.quote: Each student receives a stipend that covers tuition, fees, living costs, and health insurance and is guaranteed for five years if progress is satisfactory. | Limited support is available for international students.

entry_route.value: Apply with a bachelor's (or comparable international degree); research experience is usual.
entry_route.quote: A bachelor's degree from a regionally accredited US institution or comparable degree from an international institution is required.

english_waiver.value: TOEFL is required unless you completed two semesters of college instruction in English or your university's official language of instruction was English.
english_waiver.quote: The TOEFL is required for applicants who have not completed two semesters of colleges instruction in English or whose university's official language of instruction was not English.

notes: Program page names TOEFL only; the Graduate School also accepts IELTS and Duolingo.
